title: GAP Waiver Premier 150: Declared Deductible by the Coverage That Paid the Loss
content:
**GAP Waiver Addenda, GAP Waiver Premier 150 deductible reimbursement.** The declared deductible the reimbursement takes from the declarations follows the coverage that paid the loss. The kind of loss is the one the claim record shows.

| Kind of loss the claim shows | Declared deductible taken |
|---|---|
| collision total loss | the collision deductible |
| comprehensive total loss | the comprehensive deductible |
| unrecovered theft | the comprehensive deductible |
| no loss type shown | the lower of the collision and comprehensive deductibles |

*Hypothetical cases.* Take declarations with a collision deductible of 410.00 and a comprehensive deductible of 260.00.

- On a collision total loss, the declared deductible is 410.00.
- On an unrecovered theft, it is 260.00.
- On a claim showing no loss type, it is 260.00, the lower of the two.
